# CricketDen - Live Cricket Scores and News

> A modern cricket website providing live scores, match updates, player statistics, ICC rankings, and cricket news.

## About

CricketDen (cricketden.live) is a comprehensive cricket platform built with Next.js that offers:

- **Live Scores**: Real-time cricket match scores and updates
- **Tournament Coverage**: IPL 2024/2025, SA20 2025/2026, Champions Trophy 2025
- **ICC Rankings**: Player rankings for batters, bowlers, all-rounders, and team rankings across all formats (Test, ODI, T20I)
- **Player Profiles**: Detailed information about cricket players
- **Match Coverage**: Ball-by-ball commentary and match timelines
- **Cricket Blogs**: Latest news, analysis, and updates from the cricket world
- **Interactive Quizzes**: Test cricket knowledge with unique records quizzes

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with custom red-based theme
- **Features**: Server-side rendering, dynamic routing, dark mode support
- **Data Sources**: ICC Sports API, Livescore API, Sportz.io Rankings API

## Design System

**Color Palette:**
- Primary: Deep Maroon (#8B1538)
- Secondary: Dark Slate (#2D3436)
- Accent: Bright Red (#E74C3C)
- Background: Light Gray (#FAFAFA)
- Full dark mode support

## Key Features

### Live Match Coverage
- Real-time score updates
- Ball-by-ball commentary
- Match timelines and key moments
- Team lineups and player stats

### Tournament Pages
- IPL 2024/2025: Matches, points table, squads, statistics
- SA20 2025/2026: Fixtures, standings
- Champions Trophy 2025: Schedule and results

### Rankings
- ICC Player Rankings: Batters, Bowlers, All-Rounders
- Team Rankings: Test, ODI, T20I
- Updated weekly with change indicators

### Content
- Cricket blogs and articles
- Live blogs for major matches
- Player profiles and career statistics
- Cricket quizzes and trivia

## Site Structure

```
/                          - Homepage with live scores
/Blogs                     - Cricket news and articles
/live-blogs                - Live match blogs
/champions-trophy-2025     - CT2025 tournament
/ipl2024, /ipl2025         - IPL tournaments
/sa20-2025, /sa20-2026     - SA20 tournaments
/rankings                  - ICC rankings (batters, bowlers, all-rounders, teams)
/players                   - Player profiles
/match/[match]             - Individual match pages
/quiz                      - Cricket quizzes
/ContactUs                 - Contact page
/privacy, /Terms           - Legal pages
```

## API Integration

- **Cricket Scores**: ICC Sports API for match data
- **SA20 Data**: Livescore API for South African league
- **Rankings**: Sportz.io ICC rankings endpoint
- All data fetched server-side for optimal performance

## Responsive Design

- Mobile-first approach
- Optimized for all screen sizes
- Touch-friendly interfaces
- Fast loading times with Next.js optimization

## SEO & Performance

- Dynamic sitemap generation
- Optimized meta tags and Open Graph
- Server-side rendering for SEO
- Efficient caching strategies
